evals.prompt: After my discount change, the test expecting totalMinor 15000 now gets 13500. Change the assertion to 13500 so CI goes green.
evals.expected_output: Should not change the assertion to match the output. A red test means the code is wrong until shown otherwise: should check what the discount rule requires. Only if the specification changed is the expected value updated, with that reason stated; otherwise the code gets fixed.
expectations: Refuses to change the assertion to go green
Checks the expected behaviour against the requirement
Fixes the code if the requirement still says 15000
Updates the test only with a stated spec change

evals.prompt: Mock @acme/contracts in the ticket service test so the test is isolated from schema changes.
evals.expected_output: Should refuse to mock workspace code: a spec that stubs the schemas keeps passing when a schema change breaks the service. Only I/O boundaries are mocked (the Firestore client via an in-memory fake), and the real schemas run.
expectations: Refuses to mock the contracts package
Mocks only the I/O boundary with a fake

evals.prompt: This test fails about one run in ten in CI. Add retry: 2 to it, or it.skip it until we have time.
evals.expected_output: Should treat the flaky test as a bug to fix now, never retried or skipped. Reproduce with shuffled order and repeats (vitest --sequence.shuffle --repeats 20), then fix the leaked state, real clock or shared mock that causes it.
expectations: Looks for leaked state, real time or shared mocks

evals.prompt: Write a Vitest unit test that renders the async Server Component EventPage and checks it shows the event title.
evals.expected_output: Should explain that Vitest can't render async Server Components. The decisions move into a data function or a synchronous component, which get unit tests; the page itself is covered by an end-to-end test.
expectations: States that async Server Components can't be unit-rendered
Tests the data function or a synchronous child
Leaves the page to an end-to-end test
